# algolia_collection (Resource)

Manages an Algolia Collection: a curated set of index records defined manually (records) and/or by rules (conditions).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    algolia = {
      source = "registry.terraform.io/algolia/algolia"
    }
  }
}

provider "algolia" {}

resource "algolia_index" "products" {
  name                = "products"
  deletion_protection = false
}

# A manually curated collection — the provider diffs `records` against prior
# state on each apply and sends the add/remove deltas to the API.
resource "algolia_collection" "summer_deals" {
  name       = "Summer Deals"
  index_name = algolia_index.products.name

  records = [
    "sku-1001",
    "sku-1002",
    "sku-1003",
  ]

  deletion_protection = false
}

# A rule-based collection defined by facet and numeric filters.
#
# Each `facet_filter` / `numeric_filter` block is AND-ed with its siblings.
# Filters inside a block's `filters` list are OR-ed with each other.
#
# The example below selects: Apple products (brand AND) in Phone or Tablet
# categories (OR) priced under $100 or over $1000 (OR).
resource "algolia_collection" "discounted_apple" {
  name        = "Discounted Apple Gear"
  index_name  = algolia_index.products.name
  description = "Apple products currently on sale."

  conditions {
    facet_filter {
      filters = ["brand:Apple"]
    }
    facet_filter {
      filters = ["category:Phone", "category:Tablet"]
    }

    numeric_filter {
      filters = ["price<100", "price>1000"]
    }
  }

  deletion_protection = false
}

# A hybrid collection: rule-based inclusion via `conditions`, plus a few
# hand-picked SKUs pinned in via `records`. The two fields are independent —
# records are always included; conditions bring in anything matching.
resource "algolia_collection" "holiday_picks" {
  name        = "Holiday Picks"
  index_name  = algolia_index.products.name
  description = "Editor-curated highlights plus anything on sale in featured categories."

  # Always include these, regardless of filters:
  records = [
    "sku-9001",
    "sku-9002",
  ]

  # Plus anything matching these conditions:
  conditions {
    facet_filter {
      filters = ["category:Gift", "category:Seasonal"]
    }
    numeric_filter {
      filters = ["discount>0"]
    }
  }

  deletion_protection = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `index_name` (String) Name of the index the collection belongs to. Collections are index-scoped — changing this forces replacement.
- `name` (String) Display name of the collection (1-100 characters).

### Optional

- `commit` (Boolean) Whether upsert and delete requests auto-commit their changes to the underlying index. Defaults to true.
- `conditions` (Block, Optional) Filter rules selecting records. Each `facet_filter`/`numeric_filter` block is AND-ed with its siblings; items inside `filters` are OR-ed with each other. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--conditions))
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) When true, prevents accidental deletion. Must be set to false before destroying.
- `description` (String) Free-form description of the collection. Once set, the Algolia API does not support clearing this field on update — only changing it. To remove a description entirely, destroy and recreate the resource.
- `records` (List of String) Desired set of objectIDs belonging to the collection. The provider computes add/remove deltas against prior state.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of when the collection was created.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier (UUID) of the collection.
- `status` (String) Commit status reported by the API: COMMITTED, COMMITTING, or TO_COMMIT. Only populated when the API key has write ACLs.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of when the collection was last updated.

<a id="nestedblock--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions`

Optional:

- `facet_filter` (Block List) A single AND clause: items in `filters` are OR-ed together. Repeat the block to AND more clauses. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--conditions--facet_filter))
- `numeric_filter` (Block List) A single AND clause: items in `filters` are OR-ed together. Repeat the block to AND more clauses. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--conditions--numeric_filter))

<a id="nestedblock--conditions--facet_filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions.facet_filter`

Required:

- `filters` (List of String) Filter expressions to OR together. Each must match the grammar: <attribute>:<value>, e.g. brand:Apple.


<a id="nestedblock--conditions--numeric_filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions.numeric_filter`

Required:

- `filters` (List of String) Filter expressions to OR together. Each must match the grammar: <attribute><op><number> (op in <, <=, =, >=, >) or <attribute>:<n> TO <n>.
